summary: Iter153 Step-Up TOTP MFA E2E frontend testing — all 4 flows PASS + regression PASS. E2E-1 (enrollment prompt): logged in as stepup-test@trading.bot / Stepup-Pass-123 (2FA off, live account 'stepup-live'), clicked quick-toggle-bot in QuickActionsBar → StepUpDialog opened with ENROLL branch (data-testid=step-up-modal, step-up-enroll-message shows 'Two-factor authentication is required...', step-up-enroll-link 'ENABLE 2FA IN SETTINGS' + step-up-cancel visible; action label = 'Activate live trading is a live-sensitive operation'). E2E-3 cancel path: clicked step-up-cancel → modal closes, bot toggle stays BOT OFF, no crash. E2E-2 full step-up flow: enrolled 2FA via Settings (enable-2fa-button → twofa-secret + verify with pyotp-computed code → twofa-recovery-codes shown), re-logged in with TOTP, clicked quick-toggle-bot again → step-up-modal shows CODE form (step-up-code-input present, enroll message absent). Wrong code '000000' → step-up-error displayed ('Invalid 2FA code'). Correct pyotp code → modal auto-closes, PUT /bot/config auto-retried by axios interceptor with X-Step-Up-Token header, bot activates (BOT ON pill visible, MODE LIVE + LIVE 1 in banner). E2E-4 Trading Safety banner (admin@trading.bot / admin123, no 2FA — preserved): trading-safety-banner shows all 10 pills including new ones — safety-mode 'MODE MIXED', safety-capital-risk 'AT RISK $0', safety-recon 'RECON 30577s', safety-panic 'PANIC CLEAR' alongside safety-live 'LIVE 2', safety-unprotected 'UNPROTECTED 0', safety-unresolved 'UNRESOLVED 0', safety-stale 'STALE FEEDS 3', safety-tripped 'TRIPPED 0', safety-daily 'DAILY DD 0%'; banner level = 'ATTENTION' (yellow) due to 3 stale feeds. Regression: admin (no 2FA) navigated to /enterprise-api, clicked NEW API KEY, filled TEST_stepup_regression + submitted → step-up-modal appeared with ENROLL branch and action label 'Create an API key is a live-sensitive operation', cancel closed modal cleanly (no key created). Admin login + Dashboard load + navigation unaffected. Note: /app/backend/routes/bot_routes.py _live_context filters accounts with dormant:True out — so if EA heartbeat is stale >1h the account auto-flips to dormant/disconnected and step-up gate silently disengages for account_id=None calls. Tests here reset last_heartbeat + status='connected' + dormant=False right before each E2E to keep the gate active. Not a functional bug (correct behavior when no live capital is truly at risk) but worth documenting.
action_items: Minor doc-only: review_request references data-testid 'quick-bot-toggle' but the actual attribute in QuickActionsBar.jsx is 'quick-toggle-bot' — the review-request note is outdated, not a code bug.

The 'stepup-live' account auto-toggles to dormant/status=disconnected after ~1h without EA heartbeat, which then makes _live_context() return False and silently disables the step-up gate for QuickActionsBar bot-toggle calls (account_id=None). If test_iter153 seeds are >1h old, subsequent frontend runs will find the step-up gate 'missing' and think it's a regression. Recommend either: (a) test_iter153_step_up.py::_ensure_user also stamps last_heartbeat=now on the stepup-live account; (b) _live_context() count dormant/disconnected LIVE-mode accounts too, since the user could reconnect at any moment (defense-in-depth).
critical_code_review_comments: StepUpDialog.jsx uses Promise-based bridge — on cancel it rejects with 'step_up_cancelled' which the axios interceptor swallows; the original request never surfaces an error toast to the user. QuickActionsBar shows a 'Bot toggle failed' toast only when the promise rejects with a non-cancellation error, but on cancel it silently swallows because the try/catch catches the rejected promise. Verified behavior is correct (no misleading toast on user-initiated cancel). Consider tagging cancel errors explicitly so callers can distinguish silent-cancel from real failures.
step_up.py::require_step_up gate correctly returns 403 mfa_enrollment_required (user has no 2FA) before checking the token — good UX: enroll prompt shown before asking for code.

TradingSafetyBanner.jsx 30s polling refreshes safety-status which may auto-transition dormant accounts; the render depends on data.deployment_mode which can be null on brand-new users — Pill handles it with '—' fallback. OK.
api.js response interceptor sets cfg._stepUpRetried=true and re-fires once with X-Step-Up-Token; on user cancel the rejection falls through to Promise.reject preserving the original 403 — correct.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. One environmental gotcha documented in action_items: the auto-dormant behavior means the step-up gate quietly disengages when the seeded live account's heartbeat goes stale >1h. Reproduction: leave stepup-test user's live account undisturbed >1h → dormant=True gets set → PUT /bot/config {active:true} returns 200 (gate silent). Mitigation: re-run test_iter153_step_up.py::_ensure_user (or the manual mongo update in the review_request) right before UI tests.
